claim: The isolated arm64 collector smoke read back Linux cgroup v2 1GiB memory, zero swap, 64 pids, one CPU and 4096-byte pages, then exited and its container was removed.
limitation: Infrastructure validation only, one smoke observation; collector static libc is not broker allocator identity or Pi evidence.

claim: The unchanged source History kernel passed synthetic trim/clone/drop assertions in the isolated fixture smoke: each 64KiB window retained ten 6144-byte turns.
limitation: Fixture correctness only, not comparative performance, resident heap ownership, full ConversationStore behavior, or a production memory reduction.

claim: The hard-timeout smoke stopped an isolated shell tree with a setsid descendant: exit 137 and a retained resource-exhaustion failure, followed by verified container deletion and free slots.
limitation: Intentional infrastructure failure, not a failed Dekopon benchmark. A trustworthy local Docker daemon/kernel is assumed; unavailable inspection must keep the lease.

claim: One real RT-X02 startup/idle trial completed before the screen. All 841 sample values and 33 summaries matched raw evidence; sanitized export restored into an analysis-only SQLite DB with the same idle RSS mean 26340368.786885247 B and maximum 26361856 B.
limitation: One trial proves the pipeline, not comparison, production parity, exact readiness latency or allocator attribution. No provider invocation occurred.

claim: Three fresh sequential release-replica trials each of P4 and echo in approved-v4-pilot-01-screen had mean idle RSS 61.187842 versus 24.850090 MiB, sampled-ready latency 746.737603 versus 203.370553 ms, and joined-child CPU 722.766333 versus 105.912000 ms.
limitation: Descriptive tiny screen, not per-provider cost, causal allocator attribution or production parity. Provider metadata/world/code change together; in-container observer is not calibrated; filesystem cache and guest interference are uncontrolled; readiness is a socket-polling proxy.

claim: Three synchronized source-History trials retained 1280 turns / 7864320 logical text bytes and 245760 held-clone bytes. After dropping windows the logical retained count was zero while process RSS remained 8957952 to 8962048 B.
limitation: Real fenced History methods with unused model-type stubs, not whole gateway/ConversationStore/lazy expiry. Logical counts are not allocation capacity or live heap. Resident pages after drop do not identify allocator retention, diagnose a leak or establish a production saving.

claim: All ten proof/screen attempts succeeded on their first attempt. Their raw/input/binary evidence was retained before exact container/volume deletion; independent checks observed both slots empty and no study host targets.
limitation: Trusted same-daemon ownership assumptions remain. The earlier pre-create-failure volume is safety-retained because it has no archive endpoint. The canonical database, worktree and immutable raw evidence must remain local; no off-machine backup is claimed.
